latency_slo_summary: Target SLOs: non-streaming chat p50<50ms, p95<180ms, p99<400ms for payloads <=128 tokens. Streaming SLOs: time-to-first-token (TTFT) p50<30ms, p95<120ms; steady-state per-token p50<8ms, p95<20ms. SLOs measured at client SDK by default for customer-facing SLA; server-side ingress/egress and model runtime will be used for observability and root-cause. SLA credits tied to server-side ingress p95 breach only after correlated client-side impact is confirmed.
measurement_alignment_actions: Agree on canonical timestamps: client_send_ts, client_recv_first_token_ts, client_recv_end_ts; server_ingress_ts, model_start_ts, model_emit_first_token_ts, server_egress_ts
Instrument SDK: provide patch to collect and upload lightweight timing envelopes to telemetry endpoint (sample rate 10%)
Run synthetic replay: 48h POC with production token distribution and both streaming/non-streaming flows; collect p50/p95/p99 at client and server levels
Define breach policy: require correlated client-side and server-side p95 breach for SLA credit; one-sided client measurement used for performance tuning only
Establish alerting thresholds: server p95 >150ms trigger ops page, p99 >350ms auto-scale + fallback to smaller model variant
reserved_gpu_plan: Initial proposal: reserve 4 A10-equivalent instances for baseline (sustained throughput ~12k tok/s aggregate), 2 additional instances as burst pool (auto-burst up to 6x for 30s windows). Batching target: average batch size 8 for non-streaming, dynamic batching disabled for streaming routes. Plan includes explicit warm KV-cache windows before production cutover.
sla_negotiation_points: Measurement boundary: client vs server — propose server-ingress p95 as canonical for credit calculation, but client-side metrics required for incident validation
Uptime SLA: 99.95% for dedicated pool during business hours; restoration SLA and runbook required
Cost for reserved capacity + burst: commit tier pricing with defined burst bucket and overage rates
Credits: sliding scale based on p95 and p99 breach correlated across client/server measurements
Fallback policy: automatic model fallback allowed; need agreement on quality degradation and rollback triggers
